units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:1:6">Y. Erub. V, beg. 22ᵇ</cite> (<he>דסִירְיָקִין</he>) <he>נפשה דס׳</he> the monument of the Syrians (near Tiberias).

<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 1:7">Tosef. Pes. I (II), 31</cite> <he>אין יוצאין בס׳</he> you do not comply with the law (commanding to eat unleavened ‘bread of misery’ on the first night of Passover) by eating Syrian cakes; <he>ס׳ מצויירין</he> Syrian cakes shaped in figures; Y. ib. II, 29ᵇ bot. <cite ref="O01564"><he>סרוקין</he></cite> (corr. acc.); Bab. ib. 37ᵃ. Ib. <he>סְרִיקֵי בייתוס</he> the Syrian cakes in the house of Boëthos; a. e.
